title: RabbitMQ Task Queue and RPC
description: Runnable RabbitMQ examples with durable task queues, dead-letter exchanges, prefetch, bounded retries and request-reply RPC using amqplib.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de RabbitMQ con durable task queues, dead-letter exchanges, prefetch, reintentos acotados y RPC request-reply usando amqplib.
